main_measure.name: weighted mean excess gain of the short over holding (10 bars, non-overlapping, pooled)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; fewer than 30 cases inconclusive

supporting_check.name: top minus bottom |forecast| tercile weighted excess gain

decided_by: The t-statistic lies strictly between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Holding is each coin's mean 10-bar return over the same non-overlapping grid (positions 0, 10, 20, ... of every window) pooled across its windows, the short's excess gain is -(forward return - holding), the t uses the weighted standard error sqrt(n/(n-1) * sum(w^2 (x-m)^2)) / sum(w), and terciles are equal-count splits of the short cases sorted by |forecast| compared by their weighted means.
